<thought>Based on the molecular formula C5H8O2, DBE 2, one carbonyl, two methyl groups, and the likely structure methyl crotonate (SMILES CC=CC(=O)OC), the molecule can be viewed as the ester formed by joining the acid fragment “CC=CC(=O)O” (crotonic acid) with the methyl fragment “C”. These two SMILES strings represent the connected fragments that combine to give the target compound.</thought>
<final_answer>['CC=CC(=O)O', 'C']</final_answer>
